note: Fixed before any outcomes were known. Changing anything here means a new file (ledger_v2.json) and a separate scoreboard.
primary_metric: Average return minus the S&P 500 fund over 20 trading days: shortlist ideas compared with their matched random controls.
entry: The opening price on the first trading day after the idea was recorded.
exit: The closing price on the last day of the horizon. A stock that stops trading keeps its last price.
